title: Affine quasi-finite pushforward induces a morphism of Quot functors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove that for affine quasi-finite pi: X -> Y over B the functor pi_* induces Quot_{F/X/B} -> Quot_{pi_*F/Y/B}: affineness gives G_T = pi_{T,*}F_T by the affine base-change lemma and exactness of pi_{T,*} preserves quotients; a quotient F_T -> Q defines a Quot point exactly when Q is a Cohstack object over T, and lemma-coherent-functorial provides the induced morphism on the Coh stacks, so G_T -> pi_{T,*}Q is a point of Quot_{G/Y/B}.
